expected_results: build_demo_actuators is fail-closed: risk-increasing arm actuators are wired only with the execution flag ON and a live signed host executor; the verifier-window opener and the #48 admission read-back are left unprovisioned, so provisioned() is False and confirm fails closed (EXECUTION_ACTUATORS_UNPROVISIONED) in every current environment even with the flag on.

Teardown-side actuators (disable/key-remove/admission-restore) are wired INDEPENDENT of the execution flag whenever the signed executor is available, so a stop can still disarm the host after the flag toggles off mid-session.

confirm opens the host-side INGEST verifier window via the injected opener (when provisioned) BEFORE the atomic arm, keeps it open ONLY on an armed success, and tears it down (close_all) on ANY non-armed outcome (readiness fail, unprovisioned, open-failed, arm failure/exception); a failing opener fails closed (VERIFIER_WINDOW_OPEN_FAILED) and the arm is never invoked.

Prepare performs no host call; confirm is the sole authorize-to-execute point (fresh re-auth + single-use token + provisioned actuators); server-side caps/expiry unchanged; duplicate-request protection via the one-engaged-arm invariant (ALREADY_ARMED, idempotent).

stop releases the acceptance lease only when teardown PROVED DARK: backend_dark AND not cleanup_required AND (host_dark OR no arm ever engaged). A failed or UNVERIFIED host teardown after an arm RETAINS the exclusion lease; a pure-DARK stop releases without host proof; another holder's lease and a MALFORMED lease are never touched.
No secret is read, held, printed or transferred by the provider or the orchestration; no symmetric key is added to any transfer channel (the opener stays unprovisioned).

limitations: Repository-only. Auto-merge OFF; NOT merged, NOT deployed. The execution flag COPIER_OWNER_DEMO_EXECUTION_ENABLED is OFF by default and the production verifier-window opener is deliberately unprovisioned, so production confirm stays fail-closed (EXECUTION_ACTUATORS_UNPROVISIONED).

The arm_live_lifecycle and verifier_window.close_all boundaries are mocked in these orchestration tests; the real atomic-arm rollback and the real verifier-window open/close/covers are covered by tests_lifecycle_arming / tests_verifier_window. No real host, network, key or window is exercised.
host_admission_probe has no value-blind #48 MT5_ALLOW_LIVE read-back source yet; it is left None (documented remaining integration, ADR-0128).

The production verifier-window opener (a signed host op that delivers the window key host-side; preferred asymmetric host-private/backend-public variant per ADR-0128) is NOT built here and requires a separate, Sponsor-gated host rollout.
The real #46->#48 execution still requires a separate, explicit, head/runtime-pinned Sponsor real-money GO after merge + DARK deploy + reverification.
